title: 3D laptop or phone
description: A laptop (or a phone) built in CSS 3D turns from a steep angle to face you while its lid opens and the camera pushes in; the clip or screenshot lights up on its screen with a glare and a soft shadow, then the device keeps turning slowly. A caption sits beside.

props.src: required, a screen recording (mp4) or a screenshot
props.title: heading beside the device
props.caption: one line beside it
props.pos: object-position of the screen picture (default top)
props.zoom: 1 to 2: crop into the screen picture (from pos), to leave out an edge of the clip

example.title: The same story, a website
example.caption: One story file, a deck and a site
